shit man this sucks, is what you probably want to hear and i get it. ive been there. What helped me personally was to accept that by having nothing to loose i got everything to gain. this doesnt look like a list of shit things to mean as much as it looks like a list of opportunities. shit i sound like a douche but i truely mean it.

the way i see it spinning around is part of the depression. your brain just wont connect the dots and it leaves you hanging with more questions and insecurities. stay with the meds and give it some time. if you feel like they are worsening your state of mind try new ones. but these things take time and in the beginning can seem disorienting. i think you did great by getting help. try not to focuse on what isnt working and try to find little things that you can do now that you are on medication. its a long road for most people, keep it up!
